name: s81sf_bfcol_c199r

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every pin at the face: every input in g_pin.r_* (ot_v41_kreg, incl. ze_d -> r_ze and the reset synchroniser r_rst), every output from the column's own output registers (gate2 band: 839/840 ports register-at-pin, a_ctr[13] unused; native probe 0 combinational pins). A second pin-register layer would add +1 input / +1 output edge for no structural gain; io_flop_at_pins anchors the RTL pin flops.

structural_change: S81-SAFE-FIX/C199 fallback (3 failed routes since last CLOSED): (1a) TAGREP: per-lane kept copy of the last BF tag-line stage (4,272-load net -> ~270 per copy, 0 cycles); (1b) RSPLIT zero-cycle retime of the 627-ps BF lane multiplier subnormal encode (formal-equivalent); (2) ref_tile kit replaces the bespoke route_hier flow: 432x216 (2:1) outline from synthesis area at 0.556 density, both ROMs on the 43.2 lattice with their pin faces in one 23.4-um channel, inputs spread over the FULL E face (3.6 pins/um, was 10.4/um over 74.5 um), clock pin on N above the register mass, 2-stage reset landing, io_hold 0.03.
slot_change_request: bf_col slot 450.144x198.72 -> 432.0x216.0 (frame col_h9/col_h10 owner + MU-DIE-S81: +17.28 um per row, -18.144 um width; E-face pin pitch changes -> the front tile's facing pins re-assigned top-down)
purpose: S81-SAFE-FIX/C199 10-19: ready FALLBACK for ot_v41_bf_col (compact199) if route bfh_compact199_col_pinreg_prepabs_1019 misses. Same RTL as the closed compact199 + opt-in RSPLIT define; zero data-latency change (TXN lag identical); reset +2 cycles (landing).

job.purpose: compact199 fallback kit (critical ot_v41_bf_: coordinator review + submit only)
